description: Is this package version safe to install? npm, PyPI, Go, Cargo, Maven, NuGet or RubyGems: known vulnerabilities and malicious-package reports (OSV) with CVE ids, severity and the fixing version, the version to upgrade to, latest version, deprecation, licenses, the repo's OpenSSF Scorecard, and an ok/upgrade/avoid verdict with reasons. Version defaults to the latest. Data: deps.dev and OSV.dev (CC-BY 4.0). Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.
name: package_check
